title: Hazardous haze seen in 8 Philippine areas – DENR

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A hazardous haze was observed in eight areas in the country on Thursday, Oct. 15, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources-Environmental Management Bureau (DENR-EMB) said. In its 12 p.m. advisory, the agency said, “The observed haze is possibly associated with smoke and transboundary haze from ongoing fires in Kalimantan, Indonesia, which may have been transported toward the Philippines by prevailing winds.” The DENR-EMB said it monitored high concentrations of particulate matter (PM) 2.5, which refers to fine particulate matter measuring 2.5 micrometers or less in diameter.
